# Dialog

`LhDialog` is used for displaying important information or requiring user interaction within a modal overlay.

## Basic Usage

<DemoBlock title="Basic Usage">
  <LhButton @click="visible = true">Open Dialog</LhButton>
  <LhDialog v-model="visible" title="Dialog Title">
    <p>Dialog content goes here</p>
    <template #footer>
      <LhButton @click="visible = false">Cancel</LhButton>
      <LhButton type="primary">Confirm</LhButton>
    </template>
  </LhDialog>
</DemoBlock>

## sx Quick Layout

Use the `sx` prop to quickly set spacing and sizing on the dialog root, without writing extra CSS.

<DemoBlock title="sx max width">
  <LhButton @click="visible4 = true">Open Narrow Dialog</LhButton>
  <LhDialog v-model="visible4" title="Narrow" :sx="{ maxWidth: 360 }">
    <p>This dialog is capped at 360px wide</p>
  </LhDialog>
</DemoBlock>

```vue composition
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { LhButton, LhDialog } from '@lh-ui/vue3'

const visible4 = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <!-- sx max width -->
  <LhButton @click="visible4 = true">Open Narrow Dialog</LhButton>
  <LhDialog v-model="visible4" title="Narrow" :sx="{ maxWidth: 360 }">
    <p>This dialog is capped at 360px wide</p>
  </LhDialog>
</template>
```

```vue options
<script>
import { LhButton, LhDialog } from '@lh-ui/vue3'

export default {
  components: { LhButton, LhDialog },
  data() {
    return {
      visible4: false,
    }
  },
}
</script>

<template>
  <!-- sx max width -->
  <LhButton @click="visible4 = true">Open Narrow Dialog</LhButton>
  <LhDialog v-model="visible4" title="Narrow" :sx="{ maxWidth: 360 }">
    <p>This dialog is capped at 360px wide</p>
  </LhDialog>
</template>
```

> `sx` is scaled on an `8px` base. See [sx Quick Layout](/en/guide/theme-customization#sx-quick-layout) for the full API.

## Behavior Options

<DemoBlock title="Close behavior / scroll lock / beforeClose">
  <LhButton @click="advVisible1 = true">Close by button only</LhButton>
  <LhButton @click="advVisible2 = true">No scroll lock</LhButton>
  <LhButton @click="advVisible3 = true">Async close</LhButton>
  <LhDialog
    v-model="advVisible1"
    title="Close by button only"
    :show-close="false"
    :close-on-click-modal="false"
    :close-on-press-escape="false"
  >
    <p>The corner close button is hidden; clicking the overlay or pressing Escape will not close it — only the footer button does.</p>
    <template #footer>
      <LhButton type="primary" @click="advVisible1 = false">Got it</LhButton>
    </template>
  </LhDialog>
  <LhDialog v-model="advVisible2" title="No scroll lock" :lock-scroll="false">
    <p>The page keeps scrolling while this dialog is open — handy for short, lightweight notices.</p>
  </LhDialog>
  <LhDialog v-model="advVisible3" title="Async close" :before-close="handleAdvBeforeClose">
    <p>After the close button, overlay click, or Escape, the dialog actually closes 500ms later (simulating a pre-close check).</p>
  </LhDialog>
</DemoBlock>

```vue composition
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { LhButton, LhDialog } from '@lh-ui/vue3'

const advVisible1 = ref(false)
const advVisible2 = ref(false)
const advVisible3 = ref(false)

function handleAdvBeforeClose(done: () => void) {
  setTimeout(done, 500)
}
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Close by button only -->
  <LhButton @click="advVisible1 = true">Close by button only</LhButton>
  <LhDialog
    v-model="advVisible1"
    title="Close by button only"
    :show-close="false"
    :close-on-click-modal="false"
    :close-on-press-escape="false"
  >
    <p>The corner close button is hidden; clicking the overlay or pressing Escape will not close it — only the footer button does.</p>
    <template #footer>
      <LhButton type="primary" @click="advVisible1 = false">Got it</LhButton>
    </template>
  </LhDialog>
  <!-- No scroll lock -->
  <LhButton @click="advVisible2 = true">No scroll lock</LhButton>
  <LhDialog v-model="advVisible2" title="No scroll lock" :lock-scroll="false">
    <p>The page keeps scrolling while this dialog is open — handy for short, lightweight notices.</p>
  </LhDialog>
  <!-- Async close -->
  <LhButton @click="advVisible3 = true">Async close</LhButton>
  <LhDialog v-model="advVisible3" title="Async close" :before-close="handleAdvBeforeClose">
    <p>After the close button, overlay click, or Escape, the dialog actually closes 500ms later (simulating a pre-close check).</p>
  </LhDialog>
</template>
```

```vue options

    <template #footer>
      <LhButton type="primary" @click="advVisible1 = false">Got it</LhButton>
    </template>
  </LhDialog>
  <!-- No scroll lock -->
  <LhButton @click="advVisible2 = true">No scroll lock</LhButton>
  <LhDialog v-model="advVisible2" title="No scroll lock" :lock-scroll="false">
    <p>The page keeps scrolling while this dialog is open — handy for short, lightweight notices.</p>
  </LhDialog>
  <!-- Async close -->
  <LhButton @click="advVisible3 = true">Async close</LhButton>
```

## Position and Stacking

<DemoBlock title="fullscreen / position / top / zIndex / center">
  <LhButton @click="advVisible4 = true">Fullscreen</LhButton>
  <LhButton @click="advVisible5 = true">Bottom position</LhButton>
  <LhButton @click="advVisible6 = true">Top offset + z-index</LhButton>
  <LhButton @click="advVisible7 = true">Centered content</LhButton>
  <LhDialog v-model="advVisible4" title="Fullscreen Dialog" fullscreen>
    <p>With fullscreen the dialog covers the whole viewport.</p>
  </LhDialog>
  <LhDialog v-model="advVisible5" title="Bottom Position" position="bottom">
    <p>With position set to bottom, the dialog sits near the bottom of the viewport.</p>
  </LhDialog>
  <LhDialog v-model="advVisible6" title="Top Offset + Stacking" position="top" top="10vh" :z-index="3000">
    <p>The top prop sets the distance from the viewport top; z-index controls the stacking order.</p>
  </LhDialog>
  <LhDialog v-model="advVisible7" title="Centered Content" center>
    <p>center centers the title and content (legacy; prefer position in new code).</p>
    <template #footer>
      <LhButton @click="advVisible7 = false">Cancel</LhButton>
      <LhButton type="primary" @click="advVisible7 = false">Confirm</LhButton>
    </template>
  </LhDialog>
</DemoBlock>

## Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
|------|-------------|------|---------|
| modelValue | Visibility | `boolean` | `false` |
| title | Dialog title | `string` | `''` |
| width | Dialog width | `string \| number` | `'480px'` |
| fullscreen | Whether fullscreen | `boolean` | `false` |
| showClose | Show close button | `boolean` | `true` |
| closeOnClickModal | Close on overlay click | `boolean` | `true` |
| closeOnPressEscape | Close on Escape key | `boolean` | `true` |
| draggable | Enable dragging | `boolean` | `false` |
| center | Whether to center the dialog (legacy; prefer position) | `boolean` | `false` |
| position | Dialog position: top / center / bottom | `"top" \| "center" \| "bottom"` | `'center'` |
| lockScroll | Whether to lock scrolling | `boolean` | `true` |
| beforeClose | Callback before close | `(done: () => void) => void` | — |
| top | Distance from the top (px) | `string` | `'15vh'` |
| zIndex | z-index | `number` | — |
| themeVars | Component-level theme variables, overriding ConfigProvider configuration | `{ [x: string]: string; }` | — |
| bgPattern | Component-level background pattern, overriding ConfigProvider configuration | `string` | — |
| sx | sx quick-layout props | `LhSxProps` | — |

## Events

| Event | Description | Callback |
|-------|-------------|----------|
| update:modelValue | Visibility change | `(value: boolean) => void` |
| open | Dialog opened | `() => void` |
| close | Dialog closed | `() => void` |
| opened | Emitted after the dialog is fully opened | `() => void` |
| closed | Emitted after the dialog is fully closed | `() => void` |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
|------|-------------|
| default | Dialog body content |
| title | Custom title |
| footer | Footer area |
